projects.alDia.title: AlDía — Personal & Collaborative Finance Platform
projects.alDia.description: Fullstack SaaS web application for smart personal finance management, budgeting, savings goals, and collaborative expense splitting.
projects.alDia.details.name: AlDía — Financial Management SaaS Platform
projects.alDia.details.summary: Fullstack SaaS in production for organizing personal and group finances
projects.alDia.details.context: Managing personal finances and shared expenses among couples, families, or friends often requires fragmented spreadsheets or disconnected tools. AlDía was created to centralize budget tracking, savings goals, and shared group expenses into a single modern, fast, and intuitive web platform built on a scalable cloud architecture.

Set and monitor personalized savings goals with real-time visual progress tracking
Ensure strict data privacy and isolation via PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS)
projects.alDia.details.process: The development covered the full end-to-end product lifecycle, from architecture and database design to modern UI/UX:
projects.alDia.details.process.steps: Architected fullstack solution using Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Supabase
Designed relational schema in PostgreSQL with granular Row Level Security policies
Built a polished UI/UX featuring light/dark themes, Recharts data visualization, and Framer Motion animations
Developed collaborative group workflows with invite links and automatic expense balancing
Configured continuous deployment on Vercel along with Supabase Storage integration
projects.alDia.details.result: A production-ready SaaS platform designed to scale and simplify everyday financial management.
projects.alDia.details.result.items: Comprehensive financial control with clear, actionable visual dashboards
Seamless shared expense tracking for couples, households, and trips
Modern cloud architecture with robust database-level security and high performance

Fullstack development using Next.js, React, and TypeScript
Implementation of authentication, RLS security policies, and file storage
UI/UX design using Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and Radix UI
Production deployment, performance optimization, and technical documentation

TypeScript — End-to-end type safety and code maintainability
Supabase & PostgreSQL — Relational database with Row Level Security (RLS) and Auth

projects.alDia.details.feedback: As a closed-source production SaaS, an extensive technical Showcase repository was created to thoroughly document the product's vision, architecture, security model, and tech stack, showcasing high engineering standards and modern digital product craftsmanship.

projects.cinloLabs.title: CinloLabs — B2B Dental Lab Operational SaaS
projects.cinloLabs.description: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform that digitizes end-to-end dental laboratory operations and streamlines real-time collaboration with dentists.
projects.cinloLabs.details.name: CinloLabs — Operational Management B2B SaaS
projects.cinloLabs.details.summary: Production-grade multi-tenant SaaS for dental laboratories and dental practices
projects.cinloLabs.details.context: Dental laboratories traditionally rely on fragmented spreadsheets, physical notebooks, and informal messaging to manage lab orders, patient records, and deliveries. CinloLabs eliminates operational fragmentation by centralizing production tracking, client portals, and billing into a unified multi-tenant cloud platform.
projects.cinloLabs.details.stack: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Supabase · PostgreSQL · Tailwind CSS
projects.cinloLabs.details.type: B2B SaaS Platform / Fullstack Multi-Tenant App
projects.cinloLabs.details.objective: Modernize and automate dental lab workflows by:
projects.cinloLabs.details.objective.ite: Digitizing order intake, planning, and full lifecycle tracking of prosthetic work
Providing a dedicated client portal for dentists to track work status in real time
Enforcing strict multi-tenant data isolation via PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS)
Offering customizable public landing pages per lab with built-in visual theming
projects.cinloLabs.details.process: Architected and engineered from scratch with enterprise-grade modular design:
projects.cinloLabs.details.process.steps: Implemented modular Feature-Driven Architecture (FDA) strictly decoupled into platform, tenant, products, and core domains
Configured automated CI checks (check-boundaries) to prevent forbidden cross-domain dependencies
Designed multi-level data protection combining software tenant isolation and database-level Row Level Security
Built mobile-first responsive interfaces optimized for both laboratory benches and dental offices
Created a dynamic tenant landing page engine with customizable templates and theming
projects.cinloLabs.details.result: A highly scalable, production-ready B2B SaaS platform that transforms daily dental laboratory operations.
projects.cinloLabs.details.result.items: Full operational transparency and traceability from initial work order to final delivery
Seamless collaboration between dental labs and client dentists via real-time portals
Enterprise-grade multi-tenant data security enforced by database RLS policies
Scalable architectural foundation ready for vertical expansion in the dental ecosystem

Fullstack engineering across Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
Relational database modeling in PostgreSQL and Row Level Security policies in Supabase

projects.nekoTools.description: Modern web platform offering client-side developer and digital creator utilities. Features a WebP converter, visual image resizer, palette extractor, and generators focused on speed and privacy.

projects.nekoTools.details.summary: Premium collection of creative and developer utilities processed 100% locally in the browser with zero server uploads or tracking.
projects.nekoTools.details.context: Many online image conversion or editing tools require uploading private files to third-party servers, showing intrusive ads and throttling processing speed. NekoTools solves this by running all processing locally within the user's browser using Web Workers and the Canvas API, guaranteeing blazing-fast speed, total privacy, and zero tracking.

Instant image to Base64 data URI string converter
SVG to clean React component code transformer
100% client-side local browser processing with no file uploads
Modern account-free, ad-free, and tracking-free interface
projects.nekoTools.details.process: Development focused on modular feature architecture and client-side performance:
projects.nekoTools.details.process.steps: Implementation of Web Workers for heavy visual processing tasks without blocking the UI
Extensive use of the Canvas API for real-time graphics inspection and manipulation
Cohesive, responsive, and accessible UI design system built with Tailwind CSS v4
Performance optimization with zero backend dependencies or network latency
projects.nekoTools.details.result: A fast, reliable, and beautifully designed utility platform for daily digital creation workflows.
projects.nekoTools.details.result.items: Guaranteed privacy: files are processed in memory and never leave the device
Instant visual conversion and processing with zero server latency
Intuitive user experience with full dark mode support and fluid animations
Scalable structure ready to integrate new utilities and tools seamlessly

Design of a clean, ad-free visual experience

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Frontend Engineer & Product Developer specialized in building scalable web applications and digital products focused on real user needs. I work primarily with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Vue, creating robust, maintainable interfaces with a strong focus on user experience.
about.p2: I have designed and built complete end-to-end products, from frontend architecture and solution modeling to API integrations, Laravel, Supabase, and PostgreSQL. My experience includes developing SaaS applications, authentication systems, multi-tenant architectures, administrative dashboards, file storage solutions, and AI-powered features.
about.p3: My background in design allows me to combine engineering, product thinking, and user experience to create solutions where visual quality, accessibility, performance, and maintainability work together. I enjoy solving complex problems, making technical decisions, and transforming ideas into production-ready digital products.
